title: Grace Period - Term Protect Plan
text: Grace period for the Term Protect Plan: you get 30 days to pay a missed premium (annual, half-yearly, quarterly) and 15 days for monthly mode. Life cover stays active during the grace period; a claim is paid after deducting the unpaid premium.

title: Grace Period - Wealth ULIP
text: Grace period for the Wealth ULIP: you get 30 days to pay a missed premium (annual, half-yearly, quarterly) and 15 days for monthly mode. Units stay invested, but fund management charges continue; unpaid cases move to the discontinued state after grace.

title: Grace Period - Assured Savings Plan
text: Grace period for the Assured Savings Plan: you get 30 days to pay a missed premium (annual, half-yearly, quarterly) and 15 days for monthly mode. Guaranteed additions pause if the premium stays unpaid beyond grace.

title: Grace Period - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Grace period for the Retirement Pension Plan: you get 30 days to pay a missed premium (annual, half-yearly, quarterly) and 15 days for monthly mode. After grace the pension policy lapses; accumulated value may convert to a reduced paid-up pension.

title: Payment Modes - Term Protect Plan
text: Ways to pay Term Protect Plan premiums: net banking, UPI, debit/credit card, NACH auto-debit or any branch counter. Cheques take 5 working days to realise.

title: Payment Modes - Wealth ULIP
text: Ways to pay Wealth ULIP premiums: net banking, UPI, card, ECS auto-debit or branch. Premium buys units at the NAV of the day the money is realised; cheques take 5 working days.

title: Payment Modes - Assured Savings Plan
text: Ways to pay Assured Savings Plan premiums: net banking, UPI, card, NACH auto-debit, cheque or branch. Annual mode earns a small discount in premium rate.

title: Payment Modes - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Ways to pay Retirement Pension Plan premiums: net banking, UPI, card, auto-debit or branch. Single-pay and limited-pay options are available, regular pay is the default.

title: Payment Modes - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Ways to pay Equity Mutual Fund SIP premiums: NACH mandate or UPI AutoPay on the chosen SIP date. Units are allotted at the NAV of the debit date; failed debits are retried once after 3 days.

title: Autopay - Term Protect Plan
text: Auto-pay for the Term Protect Plan: set up a NACH/ECS mandate in the app under Policies > Auto-pay. The mandate becomes active in 7 working days. To cancel, raise a request with 10 days notice. If auto-debit fails the premium must be paid manually inside the grace period.

title: Autopay - Wealth ULIP
text: Auto-pay for the Wealth ULIP: set up a NACH/ECS mandate in the app under Policies > Auto-pay. The mandate becomes active in 7 working days. To cancel, raise a request with 10 days notice. A failed debit can push the policy into discontinued state if not cured after grace.

title: Autopay - Assured Savings Plan
text: Auto-pay for the Assured Savings Plan: set up a NACH/ECS mandate in the app under Policies > Auto-pay. The mandate becomes active in 10 working days. To cancel, raise a request with 15 days notice. A cancelled mandate does not stop the premium obligation.

title: Autopay - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Auto-pay for the Retirement Pension Plan: set up a NACH/ECS mandate in the app under Policies > Auto-pay. The mandate becomes active in 10 working days. To cancel, raise a request with 15 days notice. Annual-mode customers get a reminder 15 days before the mandate date.

title: Lapse Effect - Term Protect Plan
text: What happens if you miss a Term Protect Plan premium past the grace period: The policy lapses and life cover stops. There is no surrender value, so cover is lost unless revived.

title: Lapse Effect - Wealth ULIP
text: What happens if you miss a Wealth ULIP premium past the grace period: The policy moves to the discontinued fund; units are held there with a minimum guaranteed interest and lock-in rules apply. Cover ends.

title: Lapse Effect - Assured Savings Plan
text: What happens if you miss a Assured Savings Plan premium past the grace period: The policy becomes paid-up if 2 full years of premiums were paid (reduced benefits), otherwise it lapses.

title: Lapse Effect - Retirement Pension Plan
text: What happens if you miss a Retirement Pension Plan premium past the grace period: The policy lapses before vesting; value may be converted to a reduced paid-up pension if minimum premiums were paid.

title: Revival - Term Protect Plan
text: Reviving a lapsed Term Protect Plan: revival is allowed within 5 years of the first unpaid premium. You must pay all overdue premiums with interest and submit a good-health declaration, medical tests may be required after 6 months of lapse.

title: Revival - Wealth ULIP
text: Reviving a lapsed Wealth ULIP: revival is allowed within 3 years of the first unpaid premium. You must pay all overdue premiums with interest and pay overdue charges; units are restored at the current NAV.

title: Revival - Assured Savings Plan
text: Reviving a lapsed Assured Savings Plan: revival is allowed within 5 years of the first unpaid premium. You must pay all overdue premiums with interest and submit a health declaration and pay the revival interest.

title: Revival - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Reviving a lapsed Retirement Pension Plan: revival is allowed within 5 years of the first unpaid premium. You must pay all overdue premiums with interest and submit a revival request with proof of age; no medicals are needed for short lapses.

title: Death Claim Docs - Term Protect Plan
text: Documents for a death claim under the Term Protect Plan: claim form, original policy bond, death certificate, nominee ID and bank proof, plus hospital records and police report in case of accidental death. Submit via the claim portal or any branch.

title: Death Claim Docs - Wealth ULIP
text: Documents for a death claim under the Wealth ULIP: claim form, policy bond, death certificate, nominee ID and bank details; fund value is paid at the NAV of the date of intimation. Submit via the claim portal or any branch.

title: Death Claim Docs - Assured Savings Plan
text: Documents for a death claim under the Assured Savings Plan: claim form, policy bond, death certificate, nominee KYC and bank proof; sum assured plus accrued guaranteed additions are paid. Submit via the claim portal or any branch.

title: Death Claim Docs - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Documents for a death claim under the Retirement Pension Plan: claim form, death certificate, nominee/legal-heir proof and bank details; purchase price or accumulated value is paid per plan option. Submit via the claim portal or any branch.

title: Claim Tat - Term Protect Plan
text: Claim settlement time for the Term Protect Plan: a complete claim is settled in 30 days from the last document received. Claims in the first 3 policy years go through investigation and can take up to 45 days.

title: Claim Tat - Wealth ULIP
text: Claim settlement time for the Wealth ULIP: a complete claim is settled in 10 days from the last document received. Settlement is faster because it only needs fund value computation; investigation cases take up to 30 days.

title: Claim Tat - Assured Savings Plan
text: Claim settlement time for the Assured Savings Plan: a complete claim is settled in 15 days from the last document received. Maturity and death claims follow the same timeline; discharge forms must be signed.

title: Claim Tat - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Claim settlement time for the Retirement Pension Plan: a complete claim is settled in 21 days from the last document received. Annuity commencement claims need proof of life and bank mandate verification.

title: Claim Track - All products
text: Tracking a claim: open Claims > Track in the app or portal and enter the claim reference. Status stages are Registered, Under Review, Requirement Raised, Approved and Paid. Care executives can also share status on the toll-free line.

title: Maturity Claim - Assured Savings Plan
text: Maturity claim for the Assured Savings Plan: Maturity benefit (sum assured plus guaranteed additions) is auto-credited on the maturity date if the bank mandate is verified; send the signed discharge form 30 days before.

title: Maturity Claim - Wealth ULIP
text: Maturity claim for the Wealth ULIP: On maturity the fund value is paid at the maturity-date NAV; you may also opt for a settlement option over up to 5 years.

title: Maturity Claim - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Maturity claim for the Retirement Pension Plan: At vesting you may take up to one-third as a lump sum and the rest as an annuity; send the vesting option form 60 days before.

title: Surrender Value - Term Protect Plan
text: Surrendering a Term Protect Plan: A pure term plan has no surrender value in regular-pay mode; limited-pay variants may return a small amount after year 3.

title: Surrender Value - Wealth ULIP
text: Surrendering a Wealth ULIP: Surrender is allowed only after the 5-year lock-in; the fund value is paid at NAV, and before 5 years the amount stays in the discontinued fund until year 5.

title: Surrender Value - Assured Savings Plan
text: Surrendering a Assured Savings Plan: Guaranteed surrender value is payable after 2 full years of premiums, equal to 30-90 percent of premiums paid depending on the policy year.

title: Surrender Value - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Surrendering a Retirement Pension Plan: Surrender before vesting pays the accumulated value less charges; after annuity starts there is no surrender.

title: Policy Loan - Term Protect Plan
text: Loan against a Term Protect Plan: No loan is available against a term plan because it has no surrender value.

title: Policy Loan - Wealth ULIP
text: Loan against a Wealth ULIP: Loans are not available against unit-linked plans; use partial withdrawal after the lock-in instead.

title: Policy Loan - Assured Savings Plan
text: Loan against a Assured Savings Plan: A loan up to 80 percent of the surrender value is available after 3 years, at an interest of 9.5 percent, repaid any time.

title: Policy Loan - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Loan against a Retirement Pension Plan: A loan up to 60 percent of the surrender value is available before vesting at 10 percent interest.

title: Partial Withdrawal - Wealth ULIP
text: Partial withdrawal from the Wealth ULIP: Allowed after the 5-year lock-in, up to 20 percent of fund value a year with a minimum of Rs 5000; the sum assured is reduced accordingly.

title: Partial Withdrawal - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Partial withdrawal from the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: Redeem any number of units at any time (except ELSS lock-in); money arrives in 2 to 3 business days at the redemption-date NAV.

title: Partial Withdrawal - Assured Savings Plan
text: Partial withdrawal from the Assured Savings Plan: Partial withdrawals are not allowed in a guaranteed savings plan; consider a policy loan instead.

title: Partial Withdrawal - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Partial withdrawal from the Retirement Pension Plan: Partial withdrawals are not allowed before vesting; one-third commutation is allowed at vesting.

title: Fund Switch - Wealth ULIP
text: Switching funds in the Wealth ULIP: Up to 4 free switches per policy year between equity, balanced and debt funds; each extra switch costs Rs 100. Switch requests before 3 pm use the same-day NAV.

title: Fund Switch - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Switching funds in the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: A switch is a redemption plus fresh purchase; exit load applies if units are sold within 1 year. Capital gains tax may apply.

title: Fund Switch - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Switching funds in the Retirement Pension Plan: Two free fund switches a year are allowed in the market-linked pension option; the guaranteed option cannot be switched.

title: Free Look - Term Protect Plan
text: Free-look period of the Term Protect Plan: you can cancel within 30 days of receiving the policy document and get a refund of premium after deducting medical expenses and stamp duty.

title: Free Look - Wealth ULIP
text: Free-look period of the Wealth ULIP: you can cancel within 30 days of receiving the policy document and get a refund of premium after deducting the NAV movement, mortality charges and stamp duty.

title: Free Look - Assured Savings Plan
text: Free-look period of the Assured Savings Plan: you can cancel within 30 days of receiving the policy document and get a refund of premium after deducting proportionate risk premium and stamp duty.

title: Free Look - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Free-look period of the Retirement Pension Plan: you can cancel within 30 days of receiving the policy document and get a refund of premium after deducting stamp duty and any annuity already paid.

title: Tax Benefit - Term Protect Plan
text: Tax benefit on the Term Protect Plan: Premiums qualify for deduction under Section 80C up to Rs 1.5 lakh a year and the death benefit is tax-free under Section 10(10D).

title: Tax Benefit - Wealth ULIP
text: Tax benefit on the Wealth ULIP: Premiums qualify under Section 80C; maturity is tax-free under 10(10D) if annual premium is within Rs 2.5 lakh.

title: Tax Benefit - Assured Savings Plan
text: Tax benefit on the Assured Savings Plan: Premiums qualify under 80C and maturity proceeds are exempt under 10(10D) subject to the premium-to-sum-assured conditions.

title: Tax Benefit - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Tax benefit on the Retirement Pension Plan: Contributions are eligible under Section 80CCC within the overall Rs 1.5 lakh cap; annuity payouts are taxed as income.

title: Tax Benefit - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Tax benefit on the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: Only ELSS funds give an 80C deduction; other equity funds are taxed on capital gains (12.5 percent long term above Rs 1.25 lakh).

title: Tax On Maturity - Wealth ULIP
text: Tax on maturity of the Wealth ULIP: Maturity is tax-exempt under 10(10D) if the aggregate annual premium is up to Rs 2.5 lakh, otherwise gains are taxed as capital gains.

title: Tax On Maturity - Assured Savings Plan
text: Tax on maturity of the Assured Savings Plan: Maturity is tax-exempt under 10(10D) if the premium is below 10 percent of the sum assured for policies issued after April 2012.

title: Tax On Maturity - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Tax on maturity of the Retirement Pension Plan: At vesting one-third commutation is exempt; the annuity received monthly is taxable as salary-like income.

title: Tax On Maturity - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Tax on maturity of the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: Gains are taxed as short-term (20 percent) within 1 year and long-term (12.5 percent above Rs 1.25 lakh) afterwards for equity funds.

title: Tax Certificate - All products
text: Tax certificate for 80C: download the premium paid certificate from Portal > Documents > Tax Certificate after the financial year closes in April. It lists all premiums received and is also emailed to you.

title: Kyc Update - All products
text: KYC update: complete re-KYC in the app using Aadhaar OTP or upload an officially valid document (passport, voter ID, driving licence) with a PAN copy. Verification takes up to 3 working days. Pending KYC can restrict payouts.

title: Address Change - All products
text: Change of address: submit the address change form with a self-attested proof such as Aadhaar, utility bill under 3 months old or rent agreement. Updates reflect in 5 working days and apply to all your policies.

title: Nominee Change - All products
text: Nominee change: log in, go to Policies > Nominee and add the new nominee with relationship, date of birth and share. A minor nominee needs an appointee. The nomination is effective once the e-sign OTP is verified.

title: Pan Link - All products
text: Linking PAN: add your PAN under Profile > KYC; it is validated against Aadhaar linkage. An inoperative PAN can delay maturity payouts and deducts higher TDS.

title: Contact Update - All products
text: Updating mobile or email: use the Profile > Contact page; an OTP is sent to the old and new numbers. If the old number is lost, submit a signed form with ID proof at a branch.

title: Portal Login - All products
text: Portal login and password reset: use Forgot Password on the login page, enter policy number and registered mobile, then reset via OTP. Accounts lock for 30 minutes after 5 wrong attempts.

title: Statement Download - All products
text: Statements: policy statements, fund statements and premium receipts are in Portal > Documents. Choose the period and download a PDF; it is protected with your date of birth in DDMMYYYY.

title: Duplicate Bond - All products
text: Duplicate policy bond: request through the app and pay Rs 200; a signed copy is sent in 7 working days and the e-policy is available immediately.

title: Grievance Escalation - All products
text: Escalating a complaint: level 1 is customer care, level 2 the grievance officer (reply within 14 days), then the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal and finally the Insurance Ombudsman.

title: Claim Rejection Appeal - All products
text: If a claim is repudiated you can appeal to the Grievance Redressal Committee within 90 days with additional documents, and then approach the Insurance Ombudsman free of cost.

title: Care Hours - All products
text: Customer care is available on the toll-free number and WhatsApp from 9 am to 6 pm on weekdays and 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays; the app chat works 24x7 for basic requests.

title: Sip Start - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Starting a SIP in the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: choose scheme, instalment (minimum Rs 500), date (1st to 28th) and mandate. The first instalment is debited within 3 working days.

title: Sip Pause - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Pausing a SIP: request a pause for 1 to 6 instalments in the app at least 5 working days before the SIP date. The SIP resumes automatically afterwards.

title: Sip Cancel - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Cancelling a SIP: submit a stop request in Portfolio > SIPs at least 7 working days before the next debit. Units already allotted stay invested.

title: Exit Load - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Exit load in the equity Equity Mutual Fund SIP: 1 percent if units are redeemed within 12 months of each instalment, nil after that. Liquid funds charge a graded load for 7 days.

title: Nav Cutoff - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: NAV cut-off: purchases received before 3 pm get the same-day NAV for equity funds; later requests get the next business day NAV. NAVs are published after 9 pm.

title: Elss Lockin - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: ELSS tax-saver funds have a 3-year lock-in per instalment. Every SIP instalment is locked separately and can be redeemed only after 3 years.

title: Term Eligibility - Term Protect Plan
text: Eligibility for the Term Protect Plan: entry age 18 to 65, maximum cover age 85, minimum cover Rs 50 lakh, policy term 10 to 60 years. Income proof is required for higher covers.

title: Medical Tests - Term Protect Plan
text: Medical tests for the Term Protect Plan: required based on age and cover, e.g. above Rs 1 crore after age 40 needs blood, ECG and treadmill test. Tests are free and conducted at home or a partner lab.

title: Riders - Term Protect Plan
text: Riders for the Term Protect Plan: critical illness rider (covers 34 illnesses), accidental death benefit rider and waiver of premium rider on disability.

title: Riders - Assured Savings Plan
text: Riders for the Assured Savings Plan: accidental death rider and waiver of premium rider; critical illness cover is not available on this plan.

title: Smoker Rates - Term Protect Plan
text: Smoker rates in the Term Protect Plan: tobacco users pay roughly 40 to 60 percent higher premium. Cotinine test results decide the category; quitting for 12 months can qualify you for non-smoker rates.

title: Annuity Options - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Annuity options in the Retirement Pension Plan: life annuity, life annuity with return of purchase price, joint-life annuity and annuity certain for 10 or 15 years.

title: Annuity Payout - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Annuity payouts are available monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually; monthly payout is credited on the 1st working day of each month after vesting.

title: Vesting Age - Retirement Pension Plan
text: Vesting age of the Retirement Pension Plan: the earliest vesting age is 45 and the latest 80; you choose it at purchase and may defer once by up to 5 years.

title: Charges - Wealth ULIP
text: Charges in the Wealth ULIP: premium allocation charge 2 percent, policy administration charge Rs 500 a month, fund management charge up to 1.35 percent a year and mortality charges.

title: Charges - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Charges in the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: total expense ratio ranges from 0.5 percent for direct plans to 2 percent for regular plans; there are no allocation charges.

title: Charges - Assured Savings Plan
text: Charges in the Assured Savings Plan: charges are built into the premium; no separate fund charges apply to the guaranteed portion.

title: Fund Value Nav - Wealth ULIP
text: Fund value of the Wealth ULIP: fund value equals units held multiplied by the latest NAV; NAVs are updated daily by 8 pm and visible under Portfolio > Fund Value.

title: Fund Value Nav - Equity Mutual Fund SIP
text: Fund value of the Equity Mutual Fund SIP: value equals units multiplied by the latest published NAV; the app refreshes after 9 pm and shows XIRR since your first instalment.
